'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***[[Battle of Soledar]]
****Two [[British people|British]] aid workers are killed during a [[humanitarian aid|humanitarian evacuation]] from [[Soledar]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-64394105 (BBC News)]
**[[Germany–Ukraine relations]]
***[[Chancellor of Germany|German Chancellor]] [[Olaf Scholz]] announces that [[Germany]] [[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|will send]] [[Leopard 2]] [[main battle tank]]s to [[Ukraine]], and will also allow other operators of the tanks, such as [[Poland]], to send them to Ukraine. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/germany-send-leopard-tanks-kyiv-allow-others-do-so-spiegel-2023-01-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sistan and Baluchestan insurgency]]
**Two [[Law enforcement in Iran|police officers]] are killed and a third is injured in an attack in [[Sistan and Baluchestan]], [[Iran]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2023/01/24/Two-police-officers-killed-in-armed-attack-in-Iran-s-southeast-State-media (Al Arabiya)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[List of earthquakes in 2023]]
**At least one person is killed and two others are injured by a 5.9 magnitude [[list of earthquakes in Nepal|earthquake]] in [[Bajura District|Bajura]] and [[Bajhang District]]s, [[Nepal]]. [https://myrepublica.nagariknetwork.com/news/one-killed-one-other-injured-in-earthquake-in-bajura/ (MyRepublica)]
**Three people are killed, twelve are missing and twelve are rescued after a building collapses in [[Lucknow]], [[Uttar Pradesh]], [[India]], due to the earthquake in [[Nepal]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/apartment-block-collapses-indias-lucknow-more-than-two-dozen-feared-trapped-2023-01-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[2023 Afghanistan cold snap]]
**The death toll from two weeks of cold is 124 people and about 70,000 livestock, according to the government, the majority of whom lived in [[rural area]]s. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-64386145 (BBC News)]
*[[Tornado outbreak of January 24–25, 2023]]
**A tornado outbreak strikes the [[Gulf Coast of the United States]], prompting the [[National Weather Service]] to issue a rare [[tornado emergency]] for areas east of [[Houston|Houston, Texas]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/01/24/us/south-tornado-threat.html (''The New York Times'')]
*A [[Cessna 206]] with six people on board goes missing in [[Isabela (province)|Isabela]], [[Philippines]]. Rescue operations are being conducted. [https://global.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202301/25/WS63d00727a31057c47ebab2c6.html (Global China Daily)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Three people are killed in a shooting at a [[Circle K]] store in [[Yakima, Washington|Yakima]], [[Washington (state)|Washington]], [[United States]]. The gunman later commits suicide in another location. [https://www.nbcrightnow.com/news/3-dead-after-shooting-in-yakima/article_ee19a51e-9bea-11ed-8765-b34edb3ebde3.html (KNDO-TV)] [https://www.cnn.com/2023/01/24/us/yakima-washington-shooting/index.html (CNN)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Corruption in Ukraine]]
**Several senior Ukrainian officials, including [[Office of the President of Ukraine|deputy Head of the Office of the President of Ukraine]] [[Kyrylo Tymoshenko]], four deputy ministers, and five regional governors, resign as a nationwide anti-corruption campaign is launched in [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-64383388 (BBC News)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Doomsday Clock]]
**The [[Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists]] announces that the Doomsday Clock has been moved up to 90 seconds before midnight, largely due to the [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]. [https://www.npr.org/2023/01/24/1150982819/doomsday-clock-90-seconds-to-midnight (NPR)] [https://www.cnn.com/2023/01/24/world/doomsday-clock-2023-climate-scn/index.html (CNN)]
